title.zh: 冒烟不再抢管道、也不杀别人的 Runner
title.en: Smoke stops fighting over the pipe and killing the user runner

intent.zh: 两条真问题：① 冒烟运行器的收尾会 `Get-Process KeyMouse | Stop-Process`，而编辑器自己就起了一个常驻 Runner——测试结束把它杀掉既粗鲁、又会让下一次冒烟以假失败收场；② serve 模块假定管道是空的，别人在听时它既会失败，收尾的 `runner stop` 还会把**别人的** Runner 停掉。修法：收尾只收自己起的东西（靶子与剪贴板）；serve 模块先检查管道，发现已有 Runner 就明确说明并退回（其余模块照跑），并且只在自己那个 serve 还活着时才 `runner stop`。实测：故意先起一个别人的 Runner 再跑该模块，它报出前提不满足并跳过，而那个 Runner 依然活着。
intent.en: Two real problems: the smoke runner teardown killed every KeyMouse process, including the resident Runner the editor had started - rude, and a way to make the next smoke run fail for no reason; and the serve module assumed an empty pipe, so with another Runner listening it failed and its own runner stop would take down the other one. The fix: teardown only touches what it started (the target and the clipboard); the serve module checks the pipe first, states the precondition plainly and steps aside, and only stops a runner it started itself. Measured: with a foreign Runner deliberately started, the module reports the unmet precondition, skips, and that Runner is still alive afterwards.

acceptance: 冒烟收尾不再杀所有 KeyMouse 进程（只收靶子与剪贴板）
已有别的 Runner 时，serve 模块明确说明并跳过；那个 Runner 依然活着
没有别的 Runner 时，serve 模块 8 项全过
全量冒烟与 verify.ps1 全绿
note: 冒烟只收自己起的东西；serve 模块遇到别人的 Runner 就说明并跳过。
